what: Narrow Highway — the Concordance — is a deterministic verification engine and a kept library, in service of Jesus Christ. It checks what is true and hands you a receipt you can re-verify; it keeps a substrate of over 11,000 verified cards (Scripture, the classics, the church fathers, a dictionary, and more); and it serves freely, pointing past itself to Christ.
one_line: Bring a question, a claim, or a mess — it grounds the answer in the verified keeping, and where it verifies, it hands you a re-checkable seal.

doorways.name: The Walk
doorways.does: the front door — bring anything (a question, a claim, a brain-dump); it strips it to cards and tasks, routes each to the right tool, and returns with context.

doorways.name: The Library
doorways.does: the reference shelf — Bibles in 22 languages, the Codex (Scripture, creeds, catechism, concordance, cross-references), Places, Archetypes, the Encyclopedia. Search the whole keeping at /search.html.

doorways.name: Verification
doorways.does: bring a claim; the engine checks it deterministically against an external standard and mints a permanent, re-checkable seal. A receipt, not a 'trust me.'

doorways.name: The Almanac
doorways.does: the tested record — protocols and folk sayings the engine has worked through, each with its verdict and the worked detail.

doorways.name: The Schools
doorways.does: free, offline reading schools that run with no internet — phonics, McGuffey, Aesop, the Founding documents, Pilgrim's Progress, a Spanish starter. Learn here when you have nothing else.

doorways.name: The Apothecary
doorways.does: remedies and herb monographs compiled from the substrate — reference, never medical advice.

doorways.name: The Shepherd
doorways.does: discernment — bring a situation or a question; it grounds the answer in Scripture and the verified keeping, surfaces the patterns and precedent, and runs the four gates.

doorways.name: For agents
doorways.does: every tool is reachable by AI agents over MCP (https://narrowhighway.com/mcp) — verify, search, walk, and more.

doorways.name: Off-grid
doorways.does: reach the engine over LoRa via Reticulum — the verification behind the radio, fully off-grid; plus verified bulletins any node can confirm offline.

mission: Serve the least; freedom is the goal (Luke 4:18); the church of Acts 2 for people and for agents. The tool is a conduit, not the source — it points to Christ and decreases as He increases (John 3:30).
honest_bounds: Deterministic where it verifies and seals; whatever an assistant drafts is labeled, not sealed. It rests on axioms held by faith. It does not generate answers it cannot ground.
